events.title: Guido of Arezzo's notation system spreads
events.summary: Guido of Arezzo's teaching methods and staff notation helped singers learn chant more reliably, making written music a stronger tool for memory, training, and institutional transmission.
events.summaryZh: 圭多·达雷佐的教学方法和谱线记谱帮助歌者更可靠地学习圣咏，让书写音乐成为记忆、训练和机构传承的更强工具。
sourceNotes: Guido of Arezzo is conventionally associated with staff notation and pedagogical reforms in medieval Western music.
events.imageAlt: A diagram of the Guidonian hand used to teach musical notes.
events.imageCaption: The Guidonian hand visualized pitch relationships for singers learning chant.
events.imageCaptionZh: 圭多之手把音高关系视觉化，帮助歌者学习圣咏。

events.title: Peri's Euridice premieres in Florence
events.titleZh: 佩里的《欧律狄刻》在佛罗伦萨首演
events.summary: Jacopo Peri's Euridice was performed in Florence in 1600, becoming one of the earliest surviving operas and a marker of how court spectacle, poetry, and music combined into a new staged form.
events.summaryZh: 雅各布·佩里的《欧律狄刻》于 1600 年在佛罗伦萨演出，是现存最早的歌剧之一，标志宫廷奇观、诗歌和音乐结合成新的舞台形式。
sourceNotes: Euridice is widely treated as one of the earliest surviving operas.
events.imageAlt: Title page of the libretto for Jacopo Peri's Euridice.
events.imageCaption: The libretto title page anchors Euridice in early opera's mix of poetry, court performance, and music.
events.imageCaptionZh: 《欧律狄刻》脚本标题页体现了早期歌剧中诗歌、宫廷表演与音乐的结合。

events.title: Vivaldi publishes The Four Seasons
events.summary: Antonio Vivaldi published The Four Seasons in 1725 as part of a printed concerto collection, showing how music print, virtuoso display, and programmatic imagery could travel beyond one performance setting.
events.summaryZh: 安东尼奥·维瓦尔第于 1725 年把《四季》收入协奏曲集出版，显示音乐印刷、炫技演奏和标题性想象如何越过单一演出场景传播。
sourceNotes: The Four Seasons appeared in Vivaldi's 1725 printed collection Il cimento dell'armonia e dell'inventione.
events.imageAlt: Title page of Vivaldi's Il cimento dell'armonia e dell'inventione.
events.imageCaption: The printed collection helped Vivaldi's concertos circulate as texts as well as performances.
events.imageCaptionZh: 这部印刷曲集让维瓦尔第的协奏曲以文本和演出双重形式流通。

events.title: Mozart's The Magic Flute premieres
events.summary: Mozart's The Magic Flute premiered in Vienna in 1791, joining popular theater, singspiel, Masonic imagery, virtuoso singing, and Enlightenment-era public entertainment.
events.summaryZh: 莫扎特的《魔笛》于 1791 年在维也纳首演，把大众剧场、德语歌唱剧、共济会意象、炫技歌唱和启蒙时代公共娱乐结合起来。
sourceNotes: The Magic Flute premiered in Vienna in 1791 and remains a standard marker in opera history.
events.imageAlt: Theater an der Wien, associated with early performances of Mozart's The Magic Flute.
events.imageCaption: Vienna's theater culture connected opera, popular entertainment, and urban publics.
events.imageCaptionZh: 维也纳剧场文化把歌剧、大众娱乐和城市公众连接起来。

events.title: Beethoven's Fifth Symphony premieres
events.titleZh: 贝多芬《第五交响曲》首演
events.summary: Beethoven's Fifth Symphony premiered in Vienna in 1808, later becoming a symbol of the concert symphony as a public, dramatic, and historically durable musical form.
events.summaryZh: 贝多芬《第五交响曲》于 1808 年在维也纳首演，后来成为交响音乐作为公共、戏剧性且历史持久音乐形式的象征。
sourceNotes: The 1808 Vienna concert premiered Beethoven's Fifth Symphony among other works.
events.imageAlt: A printed score of Beethoven's Fifth Symphony.
events.imageCaption: The Fifth Symphony became a durable object of concert culture, study, and public memory.
events.imageCaptionZh: 《第五交响曲》成为音乐会文化、学习与公共记忆中的持久对象。

events.title: Bayreuth Festival opens
events.summary: The Bayreuth Festival opened in 1876 with Wagner's Ring cycle, linking national music, purpose-built theater, elite patronage, and the modern festival as a cultural institution.
events.summaryZh: 拜罗伊特音乐节于 1876 年以瓦格纳《尼伯龙根的指环》开幕，把民族音乐、专门剧场、精英赞助和现代音乐节制度连接起来。
sourceNotes: The 1876 Bayreuth Festival is a standard milestone in Wagner reception and modern festival culture.
events.imageAlt: A scene from Das Rheingold at Bayreuth in 1876.
events.imageCaption: Bayreuth staged Wagner's music as a total cultural institution, not only a performance.
events.imageCaptionZh: 拜罗伊特把瓦格纳音乐塑造成一种总体文化制度，而不仅是演出。

events.title: Edison demonstrates the phonograph
events.summary: Thomas Edison demonstrated the phonograph in 1877, making the recording and playback of sound a public technological possibility and opening a new relation between performance and media.
events.summaryZh: 托马斯·爱迪生于 1877 年展示留声机，使声音录制与回放成为公开可见的技术可能，并开启表演与媒介的新关系。
sourceNotes: Edison's 1877 phonograph demonstration is a core event in histories of recorded sound.
events.imageAlt: Thomas Edison with an early phonograph.
events.imageCaption: The phonograph made sound reproducible and changed the economics of listening.
events.imageCaptionZh: 留声机让声音可以复制，也改变了聆听的经济结构。

events.title: Emile Berliner patents the gramophone
events.titleZh: 埃米尔·柏林纳取得唱片机专利
events.summary: Emile Berliner patented the gramophone in 1887, shifting recorded sound toward flat discs that later became easier to duplicate, sell, store, and circulate as records.
events.summaryZh: 埃米尔·柏林纳于 1887 年取得唱片机专利，把录音推向平面唱片，使声音更容易复制、销售、保存和流通。
sourceNotes: Berliner patented the gramophone in the United States in 1887, a key step toward disc records.
events.imageAlt: An early Berliner gramophone disc.
events.imageCaption: Flat discs helped recorded sound become a reproducible commodity.
events.imageCaptionZh: 平面唱片帮助录音变成可复制的商品。

events.title: First jazz record is released
events.summary: The Original Dixieland Jass Band's 1917 recording of Livery Stable Blues is often treated as the first jazz record, helping a New Orleans-linked style circulate through the commercial record industry.
events.summaryZh: 原创迪克西兰爵士乐队 1917 年录制的《Livery Stable Blues》常被视为第一张爵士唱片，帮助与新奥尔良相关的音乐风格通过商业唱片产业传播。
sourceNotes: The Original Dixieland Jass Band's 1917 release is a standard landmark in jazz recording history.
events.imageAlt: Promotional card for the Original Dixieland Jass Band.
events.imageCaption: Commercial records helped jazz move from local performance scenes into mass circulation.
events.imageCaptionZh: 商业唱片帮助爵士从地方演出场景进入大众流通。

events.title: KDKA begins commercial radio broadcasting
events.summary: KDKA's 1920 broadcasts in Pittsburgh helped make radio a public medium, creating new possibilities for music audiences beyond concert halls, theaters, and record players.
events.summaryZh: 匹兹堡 KDKA 于 1920 年开始广播，帮助无线电成为公共媒介，为音乐听众创造了超出音乐厅、剧场和唱机的新可能。
sourceNotes: KDKA is conventionally cited as an early U.S. commercial radio station, with 1920 election-night broadcasts as a landmark.
events.imageAlt: Frank Conrad's early radio station equipment.
events.imageCaption: Early broadcast equipment helped move music and speech into household media space.
events.imageCaptionZh: 早期广播设备帮助音乐和声音进入家庭媒介空间。

events.title: Columbia introduces the LP record
events.titleZh: 哥伦比亚推出 LP 唱片
events.summary: Columbia introduced the long-playing record in 1948, extending listening time and helping albums become an important format for classical music, jazz, and later popular music.
events.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚唱片于 1948 年推出长时间播放唱片，延长聆听时间，并帮助专辑成为古典、爵士和后来的流行音乐重要格式。
sourceNotes: Columbia's 1948 LP is a standard milestone in recorded music formats.
events.imageAlt: Early Columbia long-playing records.
events.imageCaption: The LP made longer musical programs commercially practical on disc.
events.imageCaptionZh: LP 让更长的音乐节目可以通过唱片商业化发行。

events.title: Elvis Presley records at Sun Studio
events.titleZh: 猫王在太阳录音室录音
events.summary: Elvis Presley recorded That's All Right at Sun Studio in 1954, a key moment in the commercial emergence of rock and roll from regional, Black, white, country, and rhythm-and-blues currents.
events.summaryZh: 埃尔维斯·普雷斯利于 1954 年在太阳录音室录制《That's All Right》，是摇滚乐从地方、黑人、白人、乡村和节奏布鲁斯潮流中商业化出现的关键时刻。
sourceNotes: Presley's 1954 Sun Studio recordings are core landmarks in rock and roll history.
events.imageAlt: Sun Studio in Memphis.
events.imageCaption: Sun Studio became a recording site where regional styles entered national popular music.
events.imageCaptionZh: 太阳录音室成为地方音乐风格进入全国流行音乐的录音地点。

events.title: The Beatles appear on The Ed Sullivan Show
events.titleZh: 披头士登上《埃德·沙利文秀》
events.summary: The Beatles' 1964 appearance on The Ed Sullivan Show turned British pop into a U.S. television event, showing how broadcast media could accelerate global youth music culture.
events.summaryZh: 披头士 1964 年登上《埃德·沙利文秀》，把英国流行乐变成美国电视事件，显示广播电视如何加速全球青年音乐文化。
sourceNotes: The Beatles' February 1964 Ed Sullivan appearance is a standard milestone in television and popular music history.
events.imageAlt: The Beatles performing on The Ed Sullivan Show.
events.imageCaption: Television made the Beatles' arrival in the United States a shared mass-media event.
events.imageCaptionZh: 电视让披头士进入美国成为共同观看的大众媒体事件。

events.title: DJ Kool Herc's Bronx party marks an early hip-hop milestone
events.titleZh: DJ Kool Herc 布朗克斯派对成为早期嘻哈里程碑
events.summary: A 1973 party associated with DJ Kool Herc at 1520 Sedgwick Avenue became a key origin story for hip-hop, linking block parties, breakbeats, sound systems, dance, and neighborhood youth culture.
events.summaryZh: 1973 年 DJ Kool Herc 在 1520 Sedgwick Avenue 相关派对成为嘻哈的重要起源叙事，把街区派对、breakbeat、音响系统、舞蹈和社区青年文化连接起来。
sourceNotes: 1520 Sedgwick Avenue and DJ Kool Herc's 1973 party are conventional reference points in hip-hop origin narratives.
events.imageAlt: 1520 Sedgwick Avenue in the Bronx.
events.imageCaption: 1520 Sedgwick Avenue became a landmark in hip-hop's origin story.
events.imageCaptionZh: 1520 Sedgwick Avenue 成为嘻哈起源叙事中的地标。

events.title: Roland releases the TR-808 drum machine
events.titleZh: Roland 发布 TR-808 鼓机
events.summary: Roland released the TR-808 in 1980, and its synthetic drum sounds later became central to hip-hop, electro, dance music, pop production, and the aesthetics of programmable rhythm.
events.summaryZh: Roland 于 1980 年发布 TR-808，其合成鼓声后来成为嘻哈、电子、舞曲、流行制作和可编程节奏美学的核心。
sourceNotes: The TR-808 is widely recognized as a landmark drum machine in popular music production.
events.imageAlt: Roland TR-808 drum machine.
events.imageCaption: The TR-808 made programmable rhythm a defining sound of late twentieth-century music.
events.imageCaptionZh: TR-808 让可编程节奏成为 20 世纪后期音乐的标志性声音。

events.title: MTV launches
events.summary: MTV launched in 1981, making music video a core part of promotion, celebrity image-making, youth television, and the relationship between songs and visual media.
events.summaryZh: MTV 于 1981 年开播，使音乐视频成为宣传、明星形象、青年电视以及歌曲与视觉媒介关系的核心部分。
sourceNotes: MTV's 1981 launch is a standard milestone in music television and cable-era media.
events.imageAlt: Early MTV logo.
events.imageCaption: MTV made visual branding and music promotion inseparable for many artists.
events.imageCaptionZh: MTV 让许多艺人的视觉品牌与音乐宣传密不可分。

events.title: Sony launches the first commercial CD player
events.titleZh: 索尼推出首款商用 CD 播放器
events.summary: Sony released the CDP-101 in 1982, helping compact discs move from laboratory and industry standard into consumer music playback.
events.summaryZh: 索尼于 1982 年推出 CDP-101，帮助 CD 从实验室和产业标准进入消费者音乐播放。
sourceNotes: The Sony CDP-101 is commonly cited as the first commercially released compact disc player.
events.imageAlt: Sony CDP-101 compact disc player.
events.imageCaption: The CDP-101 helped make digital music playback a consumer product.
events.imageCaptionZh: CDP-101 帮助数字音乐播放成为消费产品。

events.title: Napster launches
events.summary: Napster launched in 1999, turning peer-to-peer file sharing into a mass challenge to recorded-music distribution, copyright enforcement, and the business model of albums and labels.
events.summaryZh: Napster 于 1999 年上线，把点对点文件分享变成对唱片发行、版权执行以及专辑和唱片公司商业模式的大规模挑战。
sourceNotes: Napster is a standard turning point in histories of digital music distribution and copyright conflict.
events.imageAlt: Napster logo from 1999.
events.imageCaption: Napster made online music sharing a public legal and industry crisis.
events.imageCaptionZh: Napster 让在线音乐分享成为公开的法律和产业危机。

events.title: Apple introduces the iPod
events.summary: Apple introduced the iPod in 2001, pairing portable digital storage with consumer design and later tying music libraries to software, stores, and devices.
events.summaryZh: 苹果于 2001 年发布 iPod，把便携数字存储与消费设计结合，并在后来把音乐库连接到软件、商店和设备。
sourceNotes: Apple introduced the first iPod in October 2001.
events.imageAlt: First-generation iPod.
events.imageCaption: The iPod made large personal music libraries portable and device-centered.
events.imageCaptionZh: iPod 让大型个人音乐库变得便携，并围绕设备组织起来。

events.title: iTunes Music Store launches
events.summary: Apple launched the iTunes Music Store in 2003, creating a legal digital-download model that linked labels, devices, software, and per-track purchasing.
events.summaryZh: 苹果于 2003 年推出 iTunes 音乐商店，建立合法数字下载模式，把唱片公司、设备、软件和单曲购买连接起来。
sourceNotes: The iTunes Music Store launched in 2003 and became a major legal digital music marketplace.
events.imageAlt: Graph of iTunes Store song sales.
events.imageCaption: The iTunes Music Store turned digital tracks into a mainstream retail format.
events.imageCaptionZh: iTunes 音乐商店把数字单曲变成主流零售格式。

events.title: Spotify launches
events.summary: Spotify launched publicly in 2008, making licensed streaming, playlists, recommendation, and subscription access central to the next phase of music distribution.
events.summaryZh: Spotify 于 2008 年公开上线，使授权流媒体、播放列表、推荐系统和订阅访问成为音乐发行下一阶段的核心。
sourceNotes: Spotify launched publicly in 2008 and became a leading streaming music platform.
events.imageAlt: Early Spotify logo.
events.imageCaption: Spotify helped normalize streaming access instead of music ownership.
events.imageCaptionZh: Spotify 帮助把流媒体访问而非音乐所有权变成常态。

events.title: Gangnam Style becomes a global YouTube breakthrough
events.titleZh: 《江南 Style》成为全球 YouTube 突破事件
events.summary: Psy's Gangnam Style became a global YouTube phenomenon in 2012, showing how online video platforms could turn a Korean pop song into a worldwide meme, dance, and media event.
events.summaryZh: Psy 的《江南 Style》于 2012 年成为全球 YouTube 现象，显示在线视频平台如何把韩国流行歌曲变成全球迷因、舞蹈和媒体事件。
sourceNotes: Gangnam Style's 2012 YouTube circulation is a standard marker in global platform-era music culture.
events.imageAlt: Psy Gangnam Style performance branding in Seoul.
events.imageCaption: Gangnam Style made online video metrics part of global pop music visibility.
events.imageCaptionZh: 《江南 Style》让在线视频指标成为全球流行音乐可见性的一部分。

events.title: Douyin launches before TikTok's global expansion
events.titleZh: 抖音上线并开启 TikTok 全球扩张前奏
events.summary: Douyin launched in China in 2016 before TikTok's later global expansion, helping short-video platforms become major spaces for music discovery, dance challenges, and algorithmic promotion.
events.summaryZh: 抖音于 2016 年在中国上线，并成为后来 TikTok 全球扩张的前奏，帮助短视频平台成为音乐发现、舞蹈挑战和算法推广的重要空间。
sourceNotes: Douyin launched in 2016 and became the China-market precursor to TikTok's global short-video platform.
events.imageAlt: Douyin wordmark.
events.imageCaption: Douyin and TikTok made short video a major music discovery system.
events.imageCaptionZh: 抖音与 TikTok 让短视频成为重要的音乐发现系统。
